name: Naturalist 2.0.7 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
### 2.0.7 `(1.20.1)` :

2.0.7 has finally been backported to 1.20.1, thank you all for your patience and understanding! For those who are unfamiliar, I have swapped to `2.0` releases and minor releases, as I did a large update and revamp for the mod on later versions and would like to do more major updates going forward for the main version number. 


As per usual, please report issues you have in my Discord server. `NOT Starfish Studios` With that being said-

- Added 24 new animals + variants, items, and blocks from 1.21.1+
  - **New Mobs / Changes** :
    - Land : Bird, Black Bear, Capybara, Hedgehog, Komodo Dragon, Mammoth, Mole, Tiger, Turkey
    - Aquatic : Anglerfish, Blobfish, Clam, Giant Isopod, Great White Shark, Jellyfish, Piranha, Ray, Starfish, Whale
    - Small / Bugs : Ant, Crab, Desert Scorpion, Jungle Scorpion, Rat
    - Changes to older animals:
      - Bird replaces Bluejay, Canary, Cardinal, Finch, Robin and Sparrow; they are now variants instead of individual mobs.
      - Coral Snake and Rattlesnake are now merged into a single Snake mob.
      - Moose has been removed.

  - **New Blocks / Changes** : 
    - Ostrich Egg
    - Ant Hill
    - Plush Bear `(renamed from Teddy Bear)`
    - Red, Orange, Blue and Purple Starfish
    - Cattail and Duckweed have been removed.

  - **New / Changed Items** :
    - Anglerfish, Blobfish, Piranha, Clam Meat, Crab Meat, Drumstick, Mammoth Meat, and Morsels, each with a cooked version.
    - Fat, Hide, Tooth, Scorpion Poison Gland
    - Anglerfish Bucket, Blobfish Bucket, Piranha Bucket, Giant Isopod Bucket, Jellyfish Bucket, Ray Bucket, Starfish Bucket, Duckling Bucket
    - Caught Ants, Queen Ants, Bees, Crabs, Dragonflies, Fireflies, Hedgehogs, Rats, Scorpions, Silverfishs, Endermites, and Snails
      - Snails have replaced Snail Buckets and are now caught with the Capture Net.
    - Capture Net `(replaces Bug Net)`, Knapsack, Whistle
    - Wild Ones Music Disc, Death by Hogs Music Disc
    - Removed individual Bird/Snake Spawn Eggs and Cattail Fluff.

- GeckoLib is no longer required.
- MidnightLib and Cloth Config are no longer used or required.
- Fabric now removes farm animals from Savannas and Swamps, and Pigs from Forests, matching Forge, and Snail Shells can now be composted on Fabric.
- Added Field Guide and LambDynamicLights compat.

- Fixed Deer/Snail super crashes
- Fixed Turtle breeding + eggs now drop with data
- Added loot tables to Sparrow/Finch
- Fixed every animal's super() positioning
- Fixed issues with ClimbingAnimal duplication

name: Naturalist 5.0pre2 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
# CHANGELOG
- ### Removed world generation
   - Things like Cattails, Duckweed, and Savanna Lakes are no longer in Naturalist. We plan on making a biome mod, and are aiming for more parity with our Bedrock add-on.
   - These were removed in pre1 but should now properly be removed and not break worldgen mods.
- ### Fixed items missing from Fabric's creative tab
- ### Deer now drop Raw Venison instead of Cooked Venison when killed without Fire Aspect / being on fire
- ### Fixed Alligator, Elephant, and Bear attack animations.
- ### Tweaked some mob aggro speeds, follow ranges, etc.
- ### Made Snails not spawn white from Creative "Snail Bucket" items
- ### Added lang file for "entity.naturalist.robin" - should show properly now
- ### Added the _**start**_ of Xaero's compat
- ### Removed some misc. files and such

changelog:
🔧 ****************************************************************Naturalist 4.0.2 — Patch Notes****************************************************************

 ************************************************Some of these patches are specific to 1.19.2 but most were made to both versions.************************************************

- Fixed certain Lizard models not having the proper texture — deleted old extra textures.
    - Fixed Leopard Geckos not having a special tail + ported them to 1.19.2.

name: Naturalist 4.0.1 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
🔧 ****************************************************************Naturalist 4.0.1 — Patch Notes****************************************************************

- All unused recipes, sounds, models, and textures have been removed and localized so they don’t take up space.
- Added a couple recipes for Alex’s Mobs compatibility.
- Lions’ arms are now inside of their body to avoid strange visuals when maned Lions turn their heads.
- Alligators are no longer passive after killing mobs.
- Vultures now hold items in their beaks again.
- Snails no longer move while hiding.
- Vulture flight *******should******* be fixed — please report any bugs.
- Bug Nets now take damage when catching things. They also no longer put items in the off-hand — they’ll put them in your inventory or drop them on the ground if you do not have inventory space.

**********************************1.19.2 Specific :**********************************

- ******************************************************************************************1.19.2 will no longer be maintained unless there are remaining game-breaking bugs.******************************************************************************************
- Fixed Lion models — babies and lionesses did not previously have individual textures.

name: Naturalist 4.0.0 (Forge 1.20.1)
changelog:
🦋 **Naturalist 4.0.0 — World of Color**

Throughout the past year or so, we’ve gotten a lot of great feedback from the community! This version implements some of that feedback, focusing on improving older features we’ve added to the mod and aiming to improve them. Let us know what you think!

- ***Initial 1.20.1 Port !***
- Made Snails dyeable. Snails can now be right-clicked with any Vanilla Dye item to color them! Putting them in buckets will now show their color as well as a “lore” text underneath saying what color they are for colorblind folks.
- Snails can now be bred with Beetroot — they will lay a clutch of Snail Eggs which will take between 30 seconds and 2 minutes to hatch. There is a random chance of the baby amount being between 2 and 6.
- Butterflies and all bucketed mobs can now be shot out of Dispensers!
- Glow Goop can now be placed, and when not held, its display will be invisible similar to Barriers. If a block is placed in the same spot, their items will drop.
- Butterflies now have variants, and can be caught with a new item — the Bug Net! Caterpillars can also now be picked up. The caught Butterflies can be released or placed in Item Frames.
- **LOADS of misc. bugfixes and smaller features.**
